root_cause: The production pricing page returned HTTP 200 with full HTML, but the verifier waited for generic body visibility before waiting for the pricing runtime ready-v3 marker. Under responsive/runtime initialization that generic visibility gate could time out even though the page and pricing controls were present.
prevention_rule: Production interaction proofs must wait on the product-specific readiness contract and target control visibility, not generic body visibility. Generic page readiness must never block a stronger domain-specific ready marker.
evidence: GET /prijzen?interaction_proof=<sha> returned HTTP 200 with full pricing HTML while body visibility wait timed out.

invariants: pricing ready-v3 marker is authoritative readiness
loss lifecycle control must become visible
real Playwright pointer click remains mandatory
